welcome.title: Your progress, in photos
welcome.body: Track weight loss, hair or skin treatments, or anything else, with photos always framed the same way.

capture.title: Comparable photos
capture.body: Silhouettes, the previous photo as a guide, a level and a timer. For the crown, hands-free mode vibrates and shoots by itself.

privacy.title: Truly private
privacy.body: No account, no cloud. Photos stay on this device only, encrypted, and never go to the gallery.

pin.title: Protect it with a PIN
pin.body: Optional: require a PIN or biometrics to open the app. Remember to make backups — uninstalling the app deletes everything.
